query:
INSERT INTO access.idp_audit_tiers
           (tenant_id, realm_id, version, hot_days, target, domain_id, decision_pos)
         SELECT $1, $2,
                COALESCE((SELECT max(version) FROM access.idp_audit_tiers
                           WHERE tenant_id = $1 AND realm_id = $2), 0) + 1,
                $3, $4, $5, $6
